verdict.rationale: Granola's public REST API is path-versioned at /v1 and ships a dated, semantically versioned changelog (v1.0.0–v1.6.0) that lists endpoint and response changes per release. The docs explicitly publish no deprecation window or backward-compatibility commitment, so only half the story is delivered. Missing for 10: documented deprecation policy or sunset window, backward-compatibility guarantees, independent corroboration of version stability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
